verdict.rationale: There is evidence of an official Copilot CLI (github-copilot-probe-4) letting users drive Copilot from the terminal, and MCP integration lets Copilot connect to external tool servers, but a probe for a documented public API (OpenAPI/swagger) returned only 404s (github-copilot-probe-3), and no evidence pack item documents a REST/GraphQL API for programmatically driving Copilot itself. Missing for 10: a documented Copilot-specific public API (OpenAPI spec, SDK, or REST/GraphQL reference) beyond the CLI and MCP client integration.
